evidence.document: Nexperia SO16 exact marking and package review

marking.appearance_status: Nexperia lists HEF4014BT as the package marking. Typeface, orientation, placement and variable lot/date details are illustrative.

recipe.appearance_status: Illustrative example of Nexperia HEF4014BT,653; the catalogue specifies HEF4014BT without an ordering suffix. KiCad SOIC-16 model selected from Nexperia SOT109-1 package evidence. The catalogue omits package height and machine-solder footprint; Nexperia specifies 1.75 mm maximum height. This image is not a verified PCB footprint.

studio.note: Electronics adaptation of the screw product studio: three softboxes, orthographic framing, neutral floor and filmic highlights. Does not claim identical Blender AgX colour management.
